hero_sub: We started BLESSTech-ZM to make quality phone accessories accessible to every Zambian — with honest prices, genuine products, and personal service you can count on.
story_p1: BLESSTech-ZM Accessories was born out of frustration — the frustration of walking into a store and being sold fake chargers, cheap cases that crack in a week, and cables that stop working after a month. Barack and Sylvester knew there had to be a better way.
story_p2: We built BLESSTech-ZM on a simple promise: every product we sell is genuine, every price is fair, and every customer gets the kind of personal attention you'd get from a trusted friend who happens to know everything about phone accessories.
story_p3: Today we serve hundreds of customers across Lusaka through WhatsApp, delivering the same day and standing behind every product we sell. We're not just a shop — we're your go-to tech friends in Lusaka.
owner_bio: Barack leads the vision and operations at BLESSTech-ZM, personally ensuring every product meets the quality standard he'd expect for himself. Passionate about tech, community, and building something Zambia can be proud of.
cofounder_bio: Sylvester keeps the wheels turning — from logistics and supplier relations to customer fulfilment. His eye for detail and commitment to customer satisfaction is what makes same-day delivery a reality for our customers.
